# Load packages

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

dir.create("Outdoors root growth results", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Import data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("outdoors_root_growth_data.csv")
```

# Prepare variables

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Experiment = factor(Experiment),
    Species = factor(Species),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment)
  )
```

# Anova model

```{r}
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

model <- lm(New.growth.sum ~ Treatment * Species + Experiment,
   data = df)

anova_results <- Anova(model, type = 3)
anova_results 
```

```{r}
write.csv(
    anova_results,
    "Outdoors root growth results/ANOVA_table.csv")
```

# Diagnostics

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(model)
```

# Estimated marginal means

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ Treatment | Species)

pairs_df <- as.data.frame(emm$contrasts)
pairs_df

write.csv(pairs_df,
          "Outdoors root growth results/Treatment_Pairwise_Comparisons.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
